manifest.notes: The Wish Garden application contracts on Ethereum chain 1, listed in constructor dependency order. The approved brief names the owner/founder address 0x48E4E74fE1d0c14404cEB57B9fec5b21329C6ec9 itself, so it is written as a static word in every privileged slot: WishGardenTreasury owner_, the immutable operationsRecipient_ and founderRecipient_, and WishGarden owner_. Writing all four identically means ownership, operations and founder roles cannot split under any $owner resolution; the approved launch owner is this same address, so the deployment is identical to the $owner form when that resolves correctly. No argument is msg.sender (the factory) or tx.origin. WishGardenBurnSink has no owner or withdrawal path. The accepted implementation uses existing IMD at 0xD34a99Bc0f67aE1bbd63C660e6d0b0dd03E263B7: each paid candle costs 1 IMD (10^18 base units), with 30% permanently locked in the sink, 50% in the owner-managed ecosystem bucket, 10% operations and 10% founder. Sink transfers do not reduce ERC20 totalSupply; the three revenue buckets are accounted separately. Constructors are nonpayable and do not call dependencies. Purchases remain disabled until the owner binds the confirmed WishGarden address once through WishGardenTreasury.bindGarden. This required post-deployment binding is a concrete setup dependency for independent review against the constructor-only launch constraint; the manifest supplies no initialization call. Free NFT claims remain disabled until the owner separately confirms the source-pinned official collection with reviewed verification evidence. Claims consume each eligible NFT token ID once and collect no IMD. Policy and signed artifact linkage belong to services; this manifest does not attest review approval, admission, deployment or completion of owner setup.
